title: TouchGrass
claim: Product Hunt: TouchGrass — Context-aware break reminders without invasive permissions
why_good: Context-aware break reminders that don't demand invasive permissions — a privacy-respecting take on a genuine wellbeing pain.
value: Consumer subscription is a hard sell for a reminder app; better as a cheap one-time purchase or a B2B wellbeing perk.
risk: Wellbeing/break apps are a graveyard of low retention; OS-level Screen Time and free tools compete.
evidence: Health & Fitness, Productivity, Menu Bar Apps
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
